[LSIG.8.1] The v1 aggregations accumulate activity and return `0.0` before
their first data — absence of signal is genuinely zero — and never return
`null`. No null-guard is required.

| Aggregation | Before first assertion | First valid result |
|---|---|---|
| `active_fraction` | `0.0` (assumed off; biased low for ≤ W if connected while already `true`) | first `true` assertion |
| `onset_rate` | `0.0` | unbiased once instance age ≥ W (÷`min(W, elapsed)` corrects the warm-up undercount) |
| `integral` | `0.0` | first assertion |
